About.title: Frontend developer who likes shipping real things
About.p1: I'm Huy, a final-year Software Engineering student at Can Tho University. Over three internships I've built production interfaces — from clinic websites at scale to internal dashboards and an AI-powered platform for my thesis.
About.p2: I care about performance, accessibility and clean component design. My comfort zone is React and Next.js with TypeScript, but I'm just as happy wiring up a NestJS API or a PostgreSQL schema when a project needs it.
About.p3: Outside of work I write study notes (you'll find some in the Docs section) and keep experimenting with new tools to ship faster without cutting corners.
